calls.title: Seven.one<>GrowthBook - Conversation on Unleash
calls.summary: In the call, Gaurav Dani (Data Product Leader at Seven.One Entertainment Group) discussed his company's need to expand experimentation from recommendations to UX/content tests using GrowthBook, while facing internal pressure from an Italian counterpart who uses Unleash for feature flagging. Jeremy (GrowthBook CTO) addressed performance concerns, highlighting <1ms latency with local caching, SDK lightness, and a Contentful integration. Next steps include arranging a demo for the editorial team to boost GrowthBook adoption, with Jake Heier (GrowthBook sales) sending Contentful integration docs.
